scope: isolated source-evidence journal tail recovery; not a demonstrated signed-customer failure
source_state: working tree at repo_head plus the durable tail repair; committed after probe

negative_control.meaning: the unpatched append path parses the torn final line as the previous record and refuses all later appends

repair.mechanism: under the cross-process journal lock, truncate only the uncommitted final fragment to the last complete newline; preserve a complete JSON record that merely lacks a newline; fsync before appending

deployment_consequence: Before the repair, one crash/torn append would block every subsequent authenticated source-fact append on that journal and could concatenate a new record onto the fragment. The repaired path restores the journal automatically at the next append, preserving the committed prefix and its hash chain.
limits: This proves the journal append boundary in the shipping image, not a live customer transaction.
It does not prove arbitrary multi-writer crash interleavings beyond the cross-process lock and complete-line protocol.
The failed base-image run is retained as the non-vacuity control; it is not a customer failure.
